title: Fix production access error: “Canister ID Not Resolved” on https://genz-app.icp0.io

requirements.text: Add an IC domain verification file at `frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains` that includes the domain `genz-app.icp0.io` so the boundary node can recognize the domain and route requests to the correct canister.

quotes: this is the feedback am getting kindly resolve it

acceptanceCriteria: A new static file exists at `frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains`.
The file contains `genz-app.icp0.io` on its own line (or in an accepted IC domain list format).

requirements.text: Ensure the `.well-known` domain verification path is not broken by the service worker caching strategy and is always fetched from network (or safely served) without causing navigation failures.
acceptanceCriteria: The service worker does not interfere with fetching `/.well-known/ic-domains` (it should succeed even on first load and after refresh).
No redirect loop or offline fallback is triggered for `/.well-known/ic-domains` when the network is available.

requirements.text: Add a simple public troubleshooting/help section in the unauthenticated Landing page that explains, in English, what to do if the user sees “Canister ID Not Resolved”, including the correct URL `https://genz-app.icp0.io` and instructions to remove old bookmarks/shortcuts and retry.

quotes: this is the feedback am getting kindly resolve it

acceptanceCriteria: The Landing page contains a clearly titled section (e.g., “Troubleshooting Access Issues”).
The section explicitly includes the exact URL `https://genz-app.icp0.io` in visible text.
The section instructs users to delete old bookmarks/home-screen shortcuts and reopen the correct URL.

constraints: Use English for all user-facing text.
Do not edit any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose them instead).
Do not edit files listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor; only add `backend/migration.mo` if a state upgrade is required.
nonGoals: Changing the app’s product features (categories, payments, verification, messaging) beyond what is required to resolve the access error.
Implementing custom domain support beyond fixing `genz-app.icp0.io` resolution and adding the IC domain verification file.
